prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape game season-pass key art, also a NULL ALLEY map cover for NULRYTH. Create a premium monochrome anime game illustration, strictly black, white and gray, no photorealism. A small void-faced anime guardian with two white luminous eyes, angular gray helmet and ink-black clothing stands on the right, holding a stylized white sci-fi rifle lowered safely. Behind: a narrow urban alley of plain white plaster blocks, stacked angular shipping boxes against the walls, black sky and sparse thin white digital fracture lines. Strong ink silhouettes, manga halftone shading, crisp cel rendering, sophisticated quiet detail. Wide cinematic 16:9 composition: right half contains the guardian and alley, left third is almost black negative space for UI text added by code. No lettering, no words, no UI, no logo, no watermark. This is a game illustration asset, not a screenshot.
